name: Holy Star of Mystra

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Gain Three-Quarters Cover and light (Bright 5 feet, Dim 5 more). On casting and later Bonus Actions, ranged spell attack a creature within 120 feet for 4d10 + spellcasting modifier Force or Radiant. After succeeding on a save against a level 7-or-lower spell targeting only you with no area, use a Reaction to reflect it at its caster, using their spell save DC.
